tvShow.name: Helluva Boss
tvShow.overview: In Hell, imp Blitzø (the 'o' is silent) runs an assassin business targeting the world of the living, using a spell book borrowed from a prince of the underworld. With employees Moxxie, Millie, and Loona, they attempt to survive each other while keeping business afloat.

episodes.name: Helluva Boss (Pilot)
episodes.overview: Follow Blitzo (the 'o' is silent) as he attempts to run a startup killing company in a very competitive market, along with his weapons specialist Moxxie, his powerhouse Millie, and his receptionist hellhound Loona. With the help of an ancient book obtained by one of the princes of Hell, they manage to make their work possible and together they attempt to survive each other while trying to keep their business afloat.

episodes.name: Murder Family
episodes.overview: After her husband's mistress survives a violent outburst, a deceased teacher hires the I.M.P to finish the job, only to encounter a far more bizarre threat.

episodes.name: Loo Loo Land
episodes.overview: In an attempt to get Blitzø's attention, Stolas unnecessarily hires the I.M.P to work as bodyguards for him and his daughter, Octavia, while they visit Loo Loo Land, an amusement park in the Greed Ring.

episodes.name: Spring Broken
episodes.overview: Blitzø discovers that his reserved, sole parking spot has been stolen by his ex-girlfriend, succubus and famous pop star Verosika Mayday. He and the rest of the I.M.P attempt to get it back by challenging Verosika to a "demon duel."

episodes.name: C.H.E.R.U.B.
episodes.overview: An eccentric inventor killed by an experiment gone wrong hires the I.M.P to assassinate his now elderly business partner, only to find that he's being talked out of suicide by a rival organization.

episodes.name: The Harvest Moon Festival
episodes.overview: Stolas invites the I.M.P to attend the Harvest Moon Festival, an annual event taking place in the Wrath Ring that is overseen by him. However, unbeknownst to our protagonists, an insidious plot will be transpiring there.

episodes.name: Truth Seekers
episodes.overview: While on Earth, Blitzø and Moxxie are captured by demon-hunting government agents. To escape, they must fight, and come to terms with their inner fears in the process.

episodes.name: Ozzie's
episodes.overview: Moxxie and Millie celebrate their first anniversary at Ozzie's, a club in the Lust Ring. Blitzø wants in on the action, but since the club is couples only, he has no choice but to invite Stolas.

episodes.name: The Circus
episodes.overview: In a flashback to 25 years in the past, Stolas meets Blitzø, who becomes his first friend. Flash forward to shortly before the present, and they meet again for the first time since on a night that kickstarts their monthly arrangement.

episodes.name: Seeing Stars
episodes.overview: In an effort to watch Azathoth's tears descend onto Earth, an event that Stolas promised to take her to but forgot to, Octavia steals his grimoire from the I.M.P's office to do so but ends up getting lost in Hollywood.

episodes.name: Exes and Oohs
episodes.overview: The I.M.P are invited to meet a mysterious figure offering them a vague job. Upon arrival, Moxxie realizes that he is far more familiar with the place and the figure than he'd like to be.

episodes.name: Unhappy Campers
episodes.overview: Due to Blitzø being preoccupied, Moxxie takes an opportunity to lead a mission for the first time, in which he and Millie travel to Earth to investigate the death of a camper and kill the culprit.

episodes.name: Oops
episodes.overview: Upon being abducted by Crimson and Striker so that they may be used as ransom, Blitzø and Fizzarolli are forced to confront each other over their mutual hatred for each other following the explosive ending of their childhood friendship.

episodes.name: Mammon's Magnificent Musical Mid-Season Special (ft Fizzarolli)
episodes.overview: Fizzarolli participates in Mammon's annual clown pageant, which he has done every year since Mammon began hosting them and won in each of them. However, with the help of Asmodeus and Blitzø, he realizes that things need to change.

episodes.name: The Full Moon
episodes.overview: On Earth, the Cherubs partner with the D.H.O.R.K.S. after being captured by them and discovering their mutual disdain for the I.M.P. Meanwhile, in Hell, Blitzø prepares for his monthly meeting with Stolas.

episodes.name: Apology Tour
episodes.overview: After Blitzø and Stolas' transactional relationship finally comes to an apparent end, Blitzø attempts to make things right with those who he has wronged in the past.
